programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How did 21-year-old Jenna go from being a straight-A UC Berkeley student and former beauty queen to abusing heroin and meth and used as sexual currency in a drug house? Her mom is desperate to save her only child and turns to Dr. Phil for intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Facebook, unexpected things happen, like reuniting with a loved one or being fired after posting an inappropriate photograph. It can also be a lifesaver, offering a human connection when all seems lost. Dr. Phil delves into a story that made headlines.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Dr. Phil Exclusive: Lauren, 8, locked in a pitch-black closet, lice-infested, surrounded by human waste, held captive by her mother and step-father. Lauren was found naked, emaciated, weighed 25 pounds, and stood 3-feet tall. Lauren, now 18, speaks out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracey says her 23-year marriage is falling apart because husband Doug is having an affair with transgender female Essence. Tracey wants Doug to choose once and for all so that she can move on with her life. Why is she leaving the decision to him?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ashley was sexually abused by her father from ages of 5 to 18, locked in a small camper, while giving birth to four of her father's children. In her first national interview since her father's arrest, the 22-year-old mom speaks about her horrible ordeal.

programme.title: The Railrodder
programme.desc: A screen short starring Buster Keaton, this is one of the last films of the comedian's long career. As "the railrodder" he crosses Canada from east to west on a railway track speeder. As might be expected, the film is full of sight gags.

programme.title: Illuminated Lives A Brief History Of Womens Work In The Middle Ages
programme.desc: The popular image of the Middle Ages comes from fairy tales and romances. This animated short challenges some enduring myths about medieval women and shows what their lives were really like.

programme.title: Notmans World
programme.desc: William Notman was a man of rare talent. Photography was still in its infancy when he opened his first studio--in Montréal--in the late 1850s. He rapidly turned his art, and a budding technology, into a highly successful business.

programme.title: Last Chance
programme.desc: Last Chance by Paul Émile d’Entremont travels the world to tell the stories of five asylum seekers who flee their native countries to escape homophobic violence. Here in Canada, they face hurdles integrating into society and fear deportation.

programme.title: Holy Angels
programme.desc: Jay Cardinal Villeneuve’s short documentary Holy Angels powerfully recaptures Canada’s colonialist history through impressionistic images and the fragmented language of a child.

programme.title: Listening For Something Adrienne Rich And Dionne Brand In Conversation
programme.desc: The nation, the country, where do we belong in it? In this film through conversation and poetry two poets meet for the telling and the listening. Topics include political issues, feminism, racism and lesbianism, among others.

programme.title: Vendetta Song
programme.desc: Filmmaker Eylem Kaftan unravels her aunt's 30-year-old murder mystery in Kurdish Turkey. "Vendetta Song" explores customs and Eylem's quest for closure amid political instability and potential retribution.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
